senses.gloss: f. pl. (תְּמַהּ) dwellers in desolation, desert beasts.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 13:22">Targ. Is. XIII, 22</cite> (h. text <he>איים</he>).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 34:14">Ib. XXXIV, 14</cite> (h. text <cite ref="R00196"><he>ציים</he></cite>); <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 50:39">Targ. Jer. L, 39</cite>. [Kimḥi to <cite ref="Ezekiel 8:14">Ez. VIII, 14</cite> quotes fr. Targ. Is. l. c.: <he>תמוזין</he>, adding that the majority of versions have <cite ref="V00657"><he>תמווין</he></cite>.]
